history.summary: One of the four Nath temples of Nath Nagari, Bareilly, and the main centre of the Naga Akhara sadhus. The shrine is a natural shivling under an ancient banyan tree; there are no priests - devotees perform their own puja. A large Hanuman statue at the entrance and a tree-lined path popular with morning walkers are key features. OPENING-HOURS CONFLICT: some sources say open 24 hours, others list 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-9:00 PM (verify locally).

name: Alakhnath Temple
town_description: Bareilly is a major city in western Uttar Pradesh on the northern Gangetic plain, traditionally called Nath Nagari for its cluster of ancient Shiva temples. A historic trade and cantonment town, it is known for zardozi embroidery, furniture and the Ala Hazrat dargah alongside its Hindu shrines, and is well connected by rail and road to Delhi and Lucknow.

travel.road: Taxis and auto-rickshaws run from Bareilly Junction; the temple sits in a green, partly forested enclave off State Highway 37.

visitor_information.best_time: November to February; early morning or evening for a peaceful visit.
